pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0125 VFX playback control
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes the remaining ADR 0125 first-release Project Rust and VfxPlayer lifecycle gap on current main. It preserves the existing VFX asset/compiler/CPU runtime/Editor architecture and adds explicit stopped/playing/paused state plus deferred start, pause, stop, restart and copied VFX state queries.

## Validation

Run normal Windows affected validation and the existing deterministic VFX Builder visual fixture.
